## Download

**`REAP_Course_Publisher.exe`** (below, under Assets) - Windows 10/11, 64-bit. One file, nothing to install.
If Windows says "Windows protected your PC": **More info** > **Run anyway** (the exe is not code-signed).

## v0.1.0 - Draft Test build

This version only tests one thing: can the app turn a YouTube Studio **Draft** into **Unlisted** without the 4 Studio steps?

1. Start the app. It reuses the auth folders from REAP YouTube Manager; check the header shows the right language and channel.
2. Tab **2. Draft Test**: paste the link of ONE draft video > **1. Read video** > **2. Make Unlisted**.
3. Refresh YouTube Studio: **Unlisted** or still **Draft**?
4. **Copy test report** and send it, together with what Studio showed.

Full guide: https://github.com/kannan983/reap-draft-publisher#user-guide
